notes.title: The Stonks Market is Now Available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/25fe395ca8e9c8e3e697ed2ac9d78971433d623f.png

How's your portfolio doing?

Today we're pleased to release The Stonks Market, right here on Steam. It's a simple trading simulator with a funny story about a rather clueless guy who gets into all kinds of trouble through the stock market.

You'll get access to a basic trading terminal, a stimulus check, and enough time to risk it all gambling on bad plays you've barely researched. All of this while you contend with a frustrated wife, too many know-it-all advisors, and the crippling fear of losing it all in an instant. Kinda like real-life, huh?

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/7dd5875707b4d4bf76c798b20bfecfcd38f8fc12.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/886ee68add5c804f1bd88f273316353a8fd26473.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/06a8eb6883f9f8f57763dd68d1404ea119e79da5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/c8711d7cb90376669f022f459fd119df39f7f9f4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/f691051397262966098218cde1f56dd70e15fcfe.png

Whether you're an avid stock bro, a crayon-eating monkey, or never touched a trading app in your life, The Stonks Market is worth a few laughs. We hope you enjoy all its wild characters and bizarre scenarios.

------

The game is available right now with a 25% Launch Discount:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554080

You can also pick it up as part The Stale Meme Collection for even more savings:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20966

Oh, and one more thing...

ALL APES TO THE MOON! 🚀 💎🙌
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/45fc131a0f75cb6626182e73ad9fddc529cfbafd.png

notes.title: 6 Month Celebration - SAM/ASM Saga Sale
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5611244/cf8841e37e2e617e40209b5645988d277e2e2322.png
Wow. The calendar just kind of melted away, huh?
It feels like yesterday we were prepping for launch, and now we're officially 6 months past release.
To celebrate, SAM is 30% off, and ASM is 70% off until October 12.

A lot has happened in that time (both in-game, and out), but it's been a great ride so far.

There have been nearly 60 build updates for Sometimes Always Monsters, including over 600 individual changes, additions or improvements, along with around 30 significant new content additions (features, scenes, or significant characters).

Needless to say, the game has changed a lot since launch, and will continue to evolve as we casually work on it. We still love adding things, improving the experience, and expanding the world players can explore with each subsequent playthrough. Thanks to its success, we have runway to continue doing this for the foreseeable future, and appreciate all of the feedback we've been given from the community.

On top of the updates, we managed to drop some Hot DLC, release Karen: An Outrage Simulator to rave reviews (our highest rated game ever), complete two game jams with our community, start preliminary work on our next major project, and maintain a routine streaming schedule.

It's been a wild half-year, and we couldn't be happier with all that's happened. Despite the world being so turbulent, our community has been incredibly supportive of our efforts, and we can't thank y'all enough. This has been one of the most productive periods in our company's history, and we've got your motivation to thank for it.

Take care, and we'll see you at the next update!
- VD

notes.title: ASM Update Prepares for Sequel's Release
notes.content:
Hey folks,
Today we're pushing out an update to Always Sometimes Monsters that prepares some backend stuff for its connectivity and save file imports to the sequel that releases tomorrow morning. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/

We've made it possible for you to bring your save files into the new game, as well as added some fun content in the end-game house for those of you who've already finished. Just take a look in the secret server room in the shed to see what "The Devs" have been up to.

It's been a long time coming, but we're so happy to share this new update with you and to finally have you all ready to jump into Sometimes Always Monsters for the first time with your original ASM continuity. If you need more detailed instructions, you can check out the blog post we made on the topic.

If you haven't gotten a look at the new game yet, take a look at the trailer:
[previewyoutube=1mrSelnqaLM;full][/previewyoutube]

Naturally, we'll be watching the forums for feedback on the update. If you have any questions or issues, that's a great place to drop a line and let us know.

Thanks to all your patient waiting for this update and release, we hope you enjoy!

- Vagabond Dog

notes.title: Launch Trailer Premieres on Feb 3rd
notes.content:
Hey Vagabonds,
It's been a while since we posted, hasn't it?
Bet you thought we were dead, or something.

For those of you who've kept up with us, you're probably aware that we've been working on a sequel to Always Sometimes Monsters that will let you carry on your adventure. Finally, it's almost here.

We're just updating you now to let you know that Monday, Feb 3rd at 10:30 AM EST, we will be premiering the Launch Trailer for Sometimes Always Monsters on our YouTube channel.

Subscribe and set your notification so you don't miss it.
[previewyoutube=1mrSelnqaLM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your patience.
We look forward to updating you more as we get closer to release.

- Vagabond Dog

notes.title: 2 Year Anniversary Patch - ASM 126
notes.content:
Today marks 2 years since we released Always Sometimes Monsters. We thought about running a sale to help celebrate the occasion, but thought it would be a more meaningful gesture of appreciation for all your support if we updated the game instead.

Thanks to all of you for playing, and supporting us this far.

ASM 126 - PATCH NOTES
==============================
- Updated swimming pool sprites with new bathing suits
- Replaced vent-crawling sprites with more appropriate animation
- Changed some dialogue in the Faith Beach pre-wedding scene
- Fixed casino toilets so Sam can use them
- Updated conversation with Bellinger at casino
- RasmusMan received improved score calculation for efficiency
- Prevented Markansas sequences from misfiring
- Secret alternate ending added
- Improved player guidance with concierge in Union Club House
- Expanded conversations with Jake/Justin
- Fixed impassable safe bug in Warehouse Office
- Save import preparation for  Sometimes Always Monsters

notes.title: 50% OFF - Always Sometimes Monsters (Now With Demo)
notes.content:
Hey Vagabonds,
Just wanted to let you all know that Always Sometimes Monsters is currently discounted 50% Off until Monday, August 18th as we release the new Always Sometimes Monsters Demo!

The demo is a unique piece of content that's a little wacky, but completely original. Those of you who have already finished the game will definitely want to give this a look. We don't want to spoil anything, but there's some really neat connections it shares to the main game.

In addition to the demo, we're also releasing Patch 1.21
============================
- Fixed minor spelling errors
- Fixed rare bug where it was possible to be trapped in Ad agency
- Fixed minor text placement error
- Fixed minor bug with City 3 dealer quest
- Firewood Quest updated
- Fixed rare bug in Meat packing where it was possible to get stuck
- Miscellaneous
============================

Lastly, we wanted to thank all of you for your support thus far and appreciate all the e-mails, tweets, and comments we've received about the game. We'll have more surprises for you in the future.

All the best,
Vagabond Dog
